user_story: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Successful booking creation with all required fields filled
steps: Fill in all required fields: first name, last name, check-in date, check-out date, and payment information
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully created, and a confirmation message is displayed

negative.title: Fail booking creation due to missing first name
steps: Fill in the last name, check-in date, check-out date, and payment information
Leave the first name field empty
negative.expected_result: Booking creation fails, and an error message indicating the missing first name is displayed

edge.title: Fail booking creation with all fields empty
edge.expected_result: Booking creation fails, and error messages indicating all required fields are missing are displayed
